**Requirements and who asked:** You want changes to ship faster and stop waiting when the lead is absent.
**Deleted:** Squads, chapters, Jira Align, and quarterly planning workshops from this launch.
**Bottleneck:** Each of the last six changes waited three days for approval from the same absent lead, after coding took less than a day.
**Checked myself:** You supplied these facts; I have not independently inspected the tracker.

To achieve your goal, I recommend reviewer coverage within the existing team and tracker. Launch this week with three rules:

- **Assign an available approver.** The author assigns each PR to one available, qualified engineer. When the lead is absent, either of the two authorized engineers can approve under the existing review criteria.
- **Keep approvals moving.** Each engineer checks assigned reviews once per working day. If the assigned reviewer becomes unavailable, the author reassigns the PR that day.
- **Check the result.** Use existing tracker statuses to measure approval waiting time for the next six changes. Aim for approval within one working day; investigate any longer wait before adding process.

The evidence supports fixing reviewer availability first. Funding and team restructuring do not address the observed delay.
